Name: ongem-web-security-headers
Comment: ongem-web behind CloudFront (WEB-SEC-05). Replace clerk.ongem.com with the Clerk customer instance Frontend API host if it differs.

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://clerk.ongem.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://img.clerk.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://clerk.ongem.com; frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

Items.Value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
